newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian copper down on sluggish demand, tin steady.
newsitem.headline: Indian copper down on sluggish demand, tin steady.

text.p: Indian copper prices fell but other base metals were steady in thin, range-bound trade on Tuesday, dealers said.
Copper prices dropped 50 rupees to 13,800 per quintal as a weak trend in the world market and sluggish local demand prompted fresh selling by stockists, dealers said.
Other base metals remained steady in light trade but sentiment was weak on poor demand and falling world prices, dealers said.
Tin was steady at 29,600 rupees per quintal, after losing 500 rupees last week. Nickel was also unchanged at 34,300 rupees per quintal after losing 500 rupees last week.
Aluminium and zinc were steady at 7,700 rupees and 8,150 rupees per quintal respectively, dealers said.
Lead was unchanged at 4,125 rupees per quintal.
